name: SubmitTranscodeJob

element_fields.help_en:
The media object type. Valid values:

- OSS: An OSS file.

- Media: A media asset ID
element_fields.help_zh:
媒体对象类型。
取值： 
- OSS: OSS文件。
- Media: 媒资 ID
element_fields.name: type

element_fields.help_en:
The media value:

- If Type is OSS, this is a URL that supports the OSS or HTTP protocol.

> You must add the OSS bucket in the URL to IMS https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html before you use it.

- If Type is Media, this is a media asset ID
element_fields.help_zh:
媒体值：
- type 为 OSS 时，为 URL, 支持 OSS 协议和 HTTP 协议。
> URL中的 OSS bucket 需要先添加到IMS https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html后再使用。

- type 为 Media 时，为媒资 ID
element_fields.name: media

element_fields.help_en:
The input stream path:

- This parameter takes effect only when Type is Media. It lets you select a specific file from the media asset as the input.

- The system checks whether the input URL exists in the media asset
element_fields.help_zh:
输入流路径：
- 仅当 type 为 Media 是才生效，让用户可以选择该媒资下的特定文件作为输入。 
 - 系统会检查该媒资下是否存在这个 inputUrl
element_fields.name: input_url

parameters.help_en: The input group for the job. A single input creates a transcoding job. Multiple inputs create a media merging job
parameters.help_zh: 任务输入组。单个输入为转码任务。多个输入为音视频合流任务
parameters.name: input_group

fields.help_en:
The media object type. Valid values:

- OSS: An OSS file.

- Media: A media asset ID
fields.help_zh:
媒体对象类型。
取值： 
- OSS: OSS文件。
- Media: 媒资 ID
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The media value:

- If Type is OSS, this is a URL that supports the OSS or HTTP protocol.

> You must add the OSS bucket in the URL to IMS https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html before you use it.

- If Type is Media, this is a media asset ID
fields.help_zh:
媒体值：
- type 为 OSS 时，为 URL, 支持 OSS 协议和 HTTP 协议。
> URL中的 OSS bucket 需要先添加到IMS https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609918.html后再使用。

- type 为 Media 时，为媒资 ID
fields.name: media

fields.help_en:
The output stream path:
This parameter takes effect only when Type is Media. It lets you select a specific file from the media asset as the output.
Valid placeholders:

- {MediaId}: The media asset ID. - {JobId}: The sub-job ID. - {MediaBucket}: The bucket where the media asset resides. - {ExtName}: The file extension. This is the output format specified in the transcoding template. - {DestMd5}: The MD5 hash of the transcoded output file. > 1. You must include both {MediaId} and {JobId} in this parameter. > > 2. The output bucket must be the same as the bucket where the media asset resides
fields.help_zh:
输出流路径：    
      仅当 Type 为 Media时才生效，让用户可以选择该媒资下特定文件作为输出。    
      支持的占位符：
- {MediaId}：媒资ID。
- {JobId}：转码子任务ID。
- {MediaBucket}：媒资ID所在的Bucket。
- {ExtName}：文件后缀，取转码模板的输出格式。
- {DestMd5}：转码输出文件的MD5值。  
> 1. 该参数必须包含{MediaId} 和 {JobId} 两个占位符。
> 2. 输出的Bucket与MediaId所在Bucket相同
fields.name: output_url

fields.help_en: The template ID
fields.help_zh: 模板 ID
fields.name: template_id

fields.help_en: The encoding format
fields.help_zh: 编码格式
fields.name: codec

fields.help_en:
The encoding profile. Valid values: baseline, main, and high.

- baseline: For mobile devices.

- main: For standard-resolution devices.

- high: For high-resolution devices.

Default value: high
fields.help_zh:
编码级别。
         支持baseline、main、high。
- baseline：针对移动设备。
- main：针对标准分辨率设备。
- high：针对高分辨率设备。
         
默认值：high
fields.name: profile

fields.help_en: The average video bitrate. Valid values: \[10, 50000]. Unit: Kbps
fields.help_zh: 视频平均码率，取值范围：[10,50000]，单位：Kbps
fields.name: bitrate

fields.help_en:
The constant rate factor (CRF), which controls the trade-off between quality and bitrate. Valid values: \[0, 51]. Default values: 23 for H.264 and 26 for H.265.

> If you set Crf, the Bitrate setting is ignored
fields.help_zh:
码率-质量控制因子，取值范围：[0,51]。默认值：编码格式为H264，默认值为23；编码格式为H265，默认值为26。
> 如果设置了Crf，则Bitrate的设置失效
fields.name: crf

fields.help_en: The width. Valid values: \[128, 4096]. Unit: px. Default value: The original video width
fields.help_zh: 宽，取值范围：[128,4096]，单位：px，默认值：视频原始宽度
fields.name: width

fields.help_en: The height. Valid values: \[128, 4096]. Unit: px. Default value: The original video height
fields.help_zh: 高，取值范围：[128,4096]，单位：px，默认值：视频原始高度
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
The frame rate. Valid values: (0, 60]. Default value: The frame rate of the input file.

> If the frame rate of the input file exceeds 60, the system uses 60
fields.help_zh:
帧率，取值范围：(0,60]，默认值：取输入文件帧率。
> 当输入文件帧率超过60时取60
fields.name: fps

fields.help_en: The maximum number of frames between keyframes. Valid values: \[1, 1080000]. Default value: 250
fields.help_zh: 关键帧间最大帧数，取值范围：[1,1080000]，默认值：250
fields.name: gop

fields.help_en: The video encoder preset. Only H.264 supports this parameter. Valid values: veryfast, fast, medium, slow, and slower. Default value: medium
fields.help_zh:
视频算法器预置。只有H264支持该参数。
支持veryfast、fast、medium、slow、slower。
默认值：medium
fields.name: preset

fields.help_en: The scan mode. Valid values: interlaced and progressive
fields.help_zh:
扫描模式。
支持interlaced、progressive
fields.name: scan_mode

fields.help_en: The video color format. Valid values include yuv420p and yuvj420p
fields.help_zh:
视频颜色格式。
         范围：yuv420p，yuvj420p等标准颜色格式
fields.name: pix_fmt

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to remove the video
fields.help_zh: 是否去掉视频
fields.name: remove

fields.help_en:
The video cropping method. Two options are available:

- Automatically detect and crop black bars. Set this to border.

- Custom cropping. Format: width:height:left:top. Example: 1280:800:0:140
fields.help_zh:
视频画面裁切支持2种方式。               
- 自动检测黑边并裁切，设置为“border”
- 自定义裁切，参数格式：width:height:left:top，示例：1280:800:0:140
fields.name: crop

fields.help_en: The padding configuration for black bars. Format: width:height:left:top. Example: 1280:800:0:140
fields.help_zh: 视频贴黑边参数，格式：width:height:left:top，示例：1280:800:0:140
fields.name: pad

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation for portrait or landscape videos (also known as long-side/short-side mode)
fields.help_zh: 是否开启横竖屏自适应（即：长短边模式）
fields.name: long_short_mode

fields.help_en: The buffer size. Valid values: \[1000, 128000]. Default value: 6000. Unit: Kb
fields.name: bufsize

fields.help_en: The peak video bitrate. Valid values: \[10, 50000]. Unit: Kbps
fields.help_zh: 视频码率峰值范围[10，50000]，单位Kbps
fields.name: maxrate

fields.help_en: The maximum bitrate for adaptive bitrate streaming (ABR). This applies only to narrow-high 1. Valid values: \[10, 50000]. Unit: Kbps
fields.help_zh: abr 最大码率（只有窄高1有效）值范围[10，50000]，单位Kbps
fields.name: abr_max

fields.help_en: The video settings
fields.help_zh: video 设置
fields.name: video

fields.help_en: The audio codec. Valid values: AAC, MP3, VORBIS, and FLAC. Default value: AAC
fields.help_zh:
音频编解码格式，AAC、MP3、VORBIS、FLAC。
         默认值：AAC
fields.name: codec

fields.help_en: The audio encoding profile. When Codec is AAC, valid values are aac\_low, aac\_he, aac\_he\_v2, aac\_ld, and aac\_eld
fields.help_zh:
音频编码预置。
         当Codec为 AAC时，范围aac_low、aac_he、aac_he_v2、aac_ld、aac_eld
fields.name: profile

fields.help_en: The sample rate. Default value: 44100. Valid values: 22050, 32000, 44100, 48000, and 96000. Unit: Hz
fields.name: samplerate

fields.help_en: The audio bitrate of the output file. Valid values: \[8, 1000]. Unit: Kbps. Default value: 128
fields.help_zh: 输出文件的音频码率，值范围：[8,1000]，单位：Kbps，默认值：128
fields.name: bitrate

fields.help_en: The number of sound channels. Default value: 2
fields.help_zh:
声道数。
         默认值：2
fields.name: channels

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to delete the audio stream
fields.help_zh: 是否删除音频流
fields.name: remove

fields.help_en: The volume adjustment method
fields.help_zh: 音量调整方式
fields.name: method

fields.help_en: The target loudness level
fields.help_zh: 目标音量
fields.name: integrated_loudness_target

fields.help_en: The true peak volume
fields.help_zh: 最大峰值
fields.name: true_peak

fields.help_en: The loudness range
fields.help_zh: 音量范围
fields.name: loudness_range_target

fields.help_en: The volume control
fields.help_zh: 音量控制
fields.name: volume

fields.help_en: The audio settings
fields.help_zh: audio 设置
fields.name: audio

fields.help_en: The container format
fields.help_zh: 容器格式
fields.name: format

fields.help_en: The container format settings
fields.help_zh: 封装格式设置
fields.name: container

fields.help_en: The segment duration
fields.help_zh: 切片时长
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en: The forced segment time points
fields.help_zh: 强制切片时间点
fields.name: force_seg_time

fields.help_en: The segment settings
fields.help_zh: 切片设置
fields.name: segment

fields.help_en: The multiplexing settings
fields.help_zh: 封装设置
fields.name: mux_config

fields.help_en:
The video transcoding mode. Valid values:

- onepass: Used for adaptive bitrate (ABR) streaming. Encoding is faster than twopass.

- twopass: Used for variable bitrate (VBR) streaming. Encoding is slower than onepass.

- CBR: Constant bitrate mode.

Default value: onepass
fields.help_zh:
视频转码模式。取值如下：

- onepass：一般用于ABR。编码速度较twopass更快。

- twopass：一般用于VBR。编码速度较onepass更慢。

- CBR：固定码率模式。

默认值：onepass
fields.name: trans_mode

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to check the video resolution. IsCheckReso and IsCheckResoFail are mutually exclusive. IsCheckResoFail has higher priority.

- true: Check the resolution. If the input video resolution (width or height) is smaller than the output setting, transcode at the input resolution.

- false: Do not check the resolution.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否检查视频分辨率。IsCheckReso和IsCheckResoFail只支持二选一，IsCheckResoFail优先级更高。

- true：检查。当输入视频分辨率（宽或高）小于输出设置时，按输入视频分辨率转码。

- false：不检查。

默认值：false
fields.name: is_check_reso

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to check the video resolution. IsCheckReso and IsCheckResoFail are mutually exclusive. IsCheckResoFail has higher priority.

- true: Check the resolution. If the input video resolution (width or height) is smaller than the output setting, return a failure.

- false: Do not check the resolution.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否检查视频分辨率。IsCheckReso和IsCheckResoFail只支持二选一，本参数优先级更高。

- true：检查。当输入视频分辨率（宽或高）小于输出设置时，返回转码失败。

- false：不检查。

默认值：false
fields.name: is_check_reso_fail

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to check the video bitrate. IsCheckVideoBitrate and IsCheckVideoBitrateFail are mutually exclusive. IsCheckVideoBitrateFail has higher priority.

- true: Check the bitrate. If the input video bitrate is lower than the output setting, transcode at the input bitrate.

- false: Do not check the bitrate.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否检查视频码率。IsCheckVideoBitrate和IsCheckVideoBitrateFail只支持二选一，IsCheckVideoBitrateFail优先级更高。

- true：检查。当输入视频码率小于输出设置时，按输入视频码率转码。

- false：不检查。

默认值：false
fields.name: is_check_video_bitrate

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to check the video bitrate. IsCheckVideoBitrate and IsCheckVideoBitrateFail are mutually exclusive. IsCheckVideoBitrateFail has higher priority.

- true: Check the bitrate. If the input video bitrate is lower than the output setting, return a failure.

- false: Do not check the bitrate.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否检查视频码率。IsCheckVideoBitrate和IsCheckVideoBitrateFail只支持二选一，本参数优先级更高。

- true：检查。当输入视频码率小于输出设置时，返回转码失败。

- false：不检查。

默认值：false
fields.name: is_check_video_bitrate_fail

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to check the audio bitrate. IsCheckAudioBitrate and IsCheckAudioBitrateFail are mutually exclusive. IsCheckAudioBitrateFail has higher priority.

- true: Check the bitrate. If the input audio bitrate is lower than the output setting, transcode at the input bitrate.

- false: Do not check the bitrate.

Default value:

- Empty and the codec differs from the input source: false.

- Empty and the codec matches the input source: true
fields.help_zh:
是否检查音频码率。IsCheckAudioBitrate和IsCheckAudioBitrateFail只支持二选一，IsCheckAudioBitrateFail优先级更高。

- true：检查。当输入音频码率小于输出设置时，按输入音频码率转码。

- false：不检查。

默认值：

- 参数为空，并且codec和输入源不一样：false。

- 参数为空，并且codec和输入源一样：true
fields.name: is_check_audio_bitrate

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to check the audio bitrate. IsCheckAudioBitrate and IsCheckAudioBitrateFail are mutually exclusive. IsCheckAudioBitrateFail has higher priority.

- true: Check the bitrate. If the input audio bitrate is lower than the output setting, return a failure.

- false: Do not check the bitrate.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否检查音频码率。IsCheckAudioBitrate和IsCheckAudioBitrateFail只支持二选一，本参数优先级更高。

- true：检查。当输入音频码率小于输出设置时，返回转码失败。

- false：不检查。

默认值：false
fields.name: is_check_audio_bitrate_fail

fields.help_en:
The method used to adjust the display aspect ratio. This parameter takes effect only when both Width and Height are specified. You can use it with LongShortMode.

Valid values: rescale, crop, pad, and none.

Default value: none
fields.help_zh:
分辨率改写方式。当Width或Height都填写时才生效，可以和LongShortMode搭配使用。

可选值：rescale、crop、pad、none。

默认值：none
fields.name: adj_dar_method

fields.help_en: The conditional transcoding parameters
fields.help_zh: 条件转码参数
fields.name: trans_config

fields.help_en: Parameters to overwrite. If you specify these, they replace the corresponding parameters in the template
fields.help_zh: 覆盖参数, 若填写会覆盖模板对应参数
fields.name: overwrite_params

fields.help_en: The transcoding configuration
fields.help_zh: 转码配置
fields.name: transcode

fields.help_en:
The width of the image watermark on the output video. Values can be one of the following:

- Integer: The pixel width of the watermark image.

  - Valid values: \[8, 4096]

  - Unit: px

- Decimal: The ratio of the watermark width to the output video width.

  - Valid values: (0, 1)

  - Up to four decimal places are supported, such as 0.9999. Extra digits are automatically discarded
fields.help_zh:
输出视频上水印图片宽。
值有两种形式：

- 整数型代水印图片宽的像素值。
  - 范围：[8,4096]
  - 单位：px
- 小数型代表相对输出视频分辨率宽的比率。
  - 范围：(0，1)
  - 支持4位小数，如0.9999，超出部分系统自动丢弃
fields.name: width

fields.help_en:
The height of the image watermark on the output video. Values can be one of the following:

- Integer: The pixel height of the watermark image.

  - Valid values: \[8, 4096]

  - Unit: px

- Decimal: The ratio of the watermark height to the output video height.

  - Valid values: (0, 1)

  - Up to four decimal places are supported, such as 0.9999. Extra digits are automatically discarded
fields.help_zh:
输出视频上水印图片高。
值有两种形式：

- 整数型代水印图片高的像素值。
  - 范围：[8,4096]
  - 单位：px
- 小数型代表相对输出视频分辨率高的比率。
  - 范围：(0，1)
  - 支持4位小数，如0.9999，超出部分系统自动丢弃
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
The horizontal offset of the image watermark relative to the output video. Default value: 0.

Values can be one of the following:

- Integer: The offset in pixels.

  - Valid values: \[8, 4096]

  - Unit: px

- Decimal: The ratio of the horizontal offset to the output video width.

  - Valid values: (0, 1)

  - Up to four decimal places are supported, such as 0.9999. Extra digits are automatically discarded
fields.help_zh:
水印图片相对输出视频的水平偏移量。
默认值：0

值有两种形式：
- 整数型代表偏移像素。
  - 范围：[8，4096]
  - 单位：px
- 小数型代表水平偏移量与输出分辨率宽的比率。
  - 范围：(0，1)
  - 支持4位小数，如0.9999，超出部分系统自动丢弃
fields.name: dx

fields.help_en:
The vertical offset of the image watermark relative to the output video. Default value: 0.

Values can be one of the following:

- Integer: The offset in pixels.

  - Valid values: \[8, 4096]

  - Unit: px

- Decimal: The ratio of the vertical offset to the output video height.

  - Valid values: (0, 1)

  - Up to four decimal places are supported, such as 0.9999. Extra digits are automatically discarded
fields.help_zh:
水印图片相对输出视频的垂直偏移量。
默认值：0

值有两种形式：
- 整数型代表偏移像素。
  - 范围[8，4096]
  - 单位：px
- 小数型代表垂直偏移量与输出分辨率高的比率。
  - 范围：(0，1)
  - 支持4位小数，如0.9999，超出部分系统自动丢弃
fields.name: dy

fields.help_en:
The position of the watermark.

- Valid values: TopRight (top-right), TopLeft (top-left), BottomRight (bottom-right), and BottomLeft (bottom-left).

- Default value: TopRight
fields.help_zh:
水印的位置。
- 可取值：TopRight（右上）、TopLeft（左上）、BottomRight（右下）、BottomLeft（左下）
- 默认值：TopRight
fields.name: refer_pos

fields.help_en:
The start time of the watermark.

- Unit: seconds

- Valid values: numbers

- Default value: 0
fields.help_zh:
水印开始出现时间。
- 单位：秒
- 取值范围：数字
- 默认值：0
fields.name: start

fields.help_en:
The duration of the watermark.

- Valid values: \[number, ToEND]
